scenes.label: hook

visual.prompt: A vast AI data center hall at night filling the frame, endless rows of glowing blue server racks, cooling pipes and cables overhead, a faint stream of rupee coins flowing in from a tiny house far away, dramatic and slightly ominous mood

scenes.vo: Aapki SIP ka paisa Meta ke AI pe kharch ho raha hai?

scenes.label: setup

visual.prompt: BHAI in his hoodie sitting at a home desk in the evening, a printed SIP statement and a laptop in front of him, pie chart drawn on a notepad with one slice highlighted, proud and confident expression, warm lamp light

scenes.vo: Bhai har mahine FANG plus ETF mein SIP karta hai. Us fund mein Meta ka hissa 10.38 percent hai.

scenes.label: choice

visual.prompt: BHAI explaining to BEHEN at the dining table, pointing at a newspaper business page with a rising bar graph drawing, BEHEN in office wear listening with folded arms, sceptical, evening tea cups on the table

scenes.vo: Uska logic simple hai, Meta umeed se zyada kamaata hai.

scenes.label: choice

visual.prompt: BHAI leaning back with hands behind his head, dreaming, a thought bubble showing a rocket made of computer chips flying upward, bright optimistic colours

scenes.vo: Toh AI pe kharcha matlab aage ki growth.

scenes.label: cost

visual.prompt: A huge construction site of a new data center at dusk, cranes lifting giant server blocks, trucks unloading crates of computer chips, mountains of dollar bills being shovelled into a furnace-like machine, scale feels enormous

scenes.vo: Par Meta ne is saal ka AI kharcha 145 billion dollar tak badha diya. Capex yaani data center aur chips pe hone wala bada kharcha.
